### Added

- Add `GINKO_CONTENT=platform`: a site whose bricks read files takes its content from the platform instead, in the build and in `ginko release`, without a code change. ([#26](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/26))

### Fixed

- Fix the first release of a template or a docs home on the platform: every required field of a single now has a default (or is optional), so the platform can create its entry. ([#28](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/pull/28))
